aliases: AXIS Q6045-C Mk II PTZ Network Camera

power.method: 12 V DC via multi-connector cable and AXIS T8605 Media Converter Switch (power supply min 75 W)

storage.notes: SD/SDHC/SDXC card with encryption; recording to NAS

features: Active cooling, operates up to 75 C; MIL-STD-810G
32x optical zoom, 12x digital zoom (384x total), autofocus
Pan 360 endless, tilt 220, up to 450 per second
256 preset positions, tour recording, guard tour, E-flip
1080p up to 30 fps, 720p up to 60 fps
WDR up to 120 dB, highlight compensation, automatic defog
AXIS T8605 Media Converter Switch with SFP fiber slots included
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (axis-q6045-c-mk-ii-ptz-network-camera-en-US-210648.pdf). Datasheet 1485648/EN/M6.2/032017. Auto-matched sheet was the indoor Q6045 Mk II datasheet; replaced.

frigate.notes: Standard Axis VAPIX RTSP path; not yet verified on this model.

home_assistant.notes: Native Axis integration with auto-discovery via Zeroconf.
